title: The Biggest Misconception in Physics
summary: Veritasium explores why energy is not conserved in general relativity, using Emmy Noether's theorem linking symmetries to conservation laws. Physicists interviewed explain energy loss in an expanding universe.
why: Recommended as high-quality physics communication and as an introduction to Noether and energy non-conservation in cosmology.

quote.text: thought wow this is good. Much better than the physics lectures I had at Cambridge Uni.
